title: Average Salary, Rounded
description:
Report the company-wide average salary, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Name the column `avg_salary`. The result is exactly one row.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
solutionSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees;
hint: AVG skips NULL salaries automatically — and over an empty table it yields NULL, which is the expected answer there.
outputExplanation: The average salary across all employees is $103,750.

tests.name: Department with no employees
Employees with NULL department and NULL salary
Single employee, single department
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'Engineering','Austin');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'Solo','Engineer',100000,1,NULL,'2022-04-01');
